Raspberry Pi 5 AI/M.2 Hat+ Snap Case

https://makerworld.com/de/models/1063966-raspberry-pi-5-ai-m-2-hat-snap-case#profileId-1052672

This is a case with a hexagonal pattern in it for good airflow, and it incorporates power button functionality. Simply press on the the tab on the back of the case, and the compliant mechanism will press the button. 

 

This snaps together nicely, but be careful with some filaments as it will be very tight, so without the Pi inside join and separate the two pieces of the case a few times to make it easier to open later.

 

This case works with the AI Hat (also the older AI M.2 Hat kit) and M.2 Hat from Raspberry Pi.

 

Make sure to print with 100% infill for strength, and also do not print with supports.

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: 0.2mm layer, 6 walls, 100% infill
- Schichthöhe: 0.2 mm
- Wandlinien: 6
- Infill: 100%
- Filament: PETG-CF (#000000)
